Pitched Mar — May 2026

Long

Amphenol

APH Semi-finalist · UC Irvine

The market prices Amphenol as a GPU NVLink copper supplier whose rack footprint is eroded by NVIDIA's shift away from internal cables. That reads the setup backwards: the cableless design raises Amphenol's dollar content per rack rather than cutting it.

  • Vera Rubin's board-to-board Paladin HD2 carries a ~$225 ASP against ~$75 for the DensiLink cables it replaces, at 396 units per rack versus 72 — a +58% uplift in content per rack versus GB300, above Evercore's 40% estimate.
  • Agentic workflows move inference from GPU-bound to CPU-bound orchestration; a Georgia Tech study puts CPU tool-processing at up to 90.6% of latency. The AI CPU market runs ~$5–8B today against a projected $50B+ by 2030–31.
  • NVIDIA's 2H27 Kyber platform lifts Paladin content from 396 to 576 units per rack, with AMD, Google, and AWS Trainium moving toward the same cableless designs.

Pitched Mar — Apr 2026

Duolingo

DUOL Hon. mention · 50 of 1,400 · Perplexity

A melting ice cube priced as a durable consumer subscription platform. Both revenue pillars — DAU-driven subscriptions and the Duolingo English Test — are decelerating structurally, not cyclically, and 52x NTM revenue leaves no room for either to disappoint.

  • Sensor Tower DAU growth collapsed from +59% to +26% to +14% YoY across three quarters, coincident with ChatGPT-4o Advanced Voice Mode — a free substitute for the core use case.
  • RevenueCat data across 30,000+ apps shows ~89% year-one churn on monthly language plans; Duolingo's own first-renewal rate fell from 40.4% to 35.3%.
  • DET posted its first-ever annual decline — $42.0M from $45.6M on -17% test volume — against F-1 visa issuance down 60% YoY in its most concentrated markets.

Pitched Nov 2025 — Mar 2026

Short

Lennar

LEN 3rd place · CFA Research Challenge

Volume held up; economics didn't. Lennar trades in line with peers on a materially weaker return profile because demand is being cleared through payment engineering rather than a price-led recovery — and the incentive spend that manufactures it lands on gross margin today.

  • Built an affordability framework spanning rent, insurance, taxes, prices, and rates: 82% R² against 42% for mortgage rates alone. Lennar's ASP screens above modeled affordability in three of four regions.
  • Incentives rose from $3.0B to $4.2B, roughly 14% of revenue, while gross margin fell from 22.5% to 18.3% — a 40bp incentive move drives an inverse 110bp margin move.
  • Ground-truthed at Tara Serena in Gainesville: captive Lennar Mortgage offering 3.75% for five years, stepping 100bp annually to 8.0% against a ~6.2% market rate — the cost capitalized into incentives, not eliminated.

Homes.com is priced for a profitable ramp precisely as Google inserts itself into the traffic funnel it depends on — while CoStar raises member pricing and cuts marketing at the same time. The sell side is 13 Buy / 5 Hold / 1 Sell into that setup.

Synopsys / Cadence

SNPS · CDNS

Long Synopsys against a relative underweight in Cadence. The market discounts Synopsys for Ansys integration, leverage, and China policy risk while paying up for Cadence as the clean-execution compounder — a spread that should narrow as organic growth and margin catch-up show up in reported results.

  • Sentiment tells the story: 77 Buy / 19 Hold / 4 Sell on Synopsys against Cadence's 93 / 7 / 0, despite the two holding a ~31% and ~30% share of the same EDA duopoly.
  • Management targets $400M of annual Ansys savings by year three; each $100M of cross-sell at 80% gross margin adds roughly $0.50 to non-GAAP EPS.
  • Cadence's own Hexagon deal is the smaller, messier one — ~$160M of 2026 revenue but $0.28 of 2026 EPS dilution before turning accretive in 2027.

Long

Sweetgreen

SG

Priced as a structurally impaired fast-casual concept. The market treats a 9–10% comp decline as permanent and pays a large premium for Cava — but fieldwork shows durable off-peak demand and a valuation gap far wider than the actual performance gap.

  • A stratified location-analytics sample across all 25 Sweetgreen states found traffic of 2.64 overall against 2.60 off-peak — demand well beyond lunch — versus Cava's 2.43 / 2.24, which leans on peak hours.
  • A Tampa location logged 23 transactions per hour off-peak with no incremental staffing: direct evidence of operating leverage.
  • Trades at 1.22x NTM EV/revenue against Cava's 6.22x on comparable revenue scale, with loyalty liability up 114% YoY as the new program shifts behavior toward repeat.

Open source · github.com/jessieyang22

The alternative-data work behind the pitches, built as reproducible code rather than one-off spreadsheets. Results are reported as they came out, including where the signal fell short.

Fama-French 5-Factor + Hiring Momentum

Python · statsmodels · 181 stocks · 2018–2025

Does a hiring-momentum signal built from LinkedIn job-posting velocity explain cross-sectional equity returns beyond the standard five factors? The premise: firms accelerating hiring are signaling revenue confidence one to two quarters before it reaches the income statement.

The factor is constructed by z-scoring quarterly posting growth across 18 SaaS names on a rolling four-quarter window, going long the top tercile and short the bottom, then forward-filling to monthly. Pricing is tested with a Fama-MacBeth two-pass regression — rolling 36-month betas, then monthly cross-sectional premia — with Newey-West standard errors at four lags, and a GRS joint test on portfolio alphas.

Model comparison · 181-stock universe, 59 cross-sectional periods
MetricFF5FF5 + HM
Avg cross-sectional R²20.0%22.0%
GRS F-statistic4.2574.223
Mean |alpha|, monthly0.602%0.603%
HM premium, monthly—+0.284%
HM t-stat (Newey-West)—1.56

Hiring momentum earns the second-highest t-statistic in the model and lifts cross-sectional R² by 9.6% relative, at roughly +3.4% annualized. It does not clear the 1.96 threshold for significance at 5%. With 59 periods and a quarterly signal forward-filled to monthly, the effective sample is nearer 20 independent observations — the honest read is limited statistical power, not an absent signal.
